# [FICTIONAL] What the plant's maintenance planner can answer — Hollinmere Energy Recovery Facility

All of this is fictional.

- Plant: 2 moving-grate (stoker) lines, 150 t/day each (300 t/day total), one condensing steam turbine generator (7.5 MWe), bag filters on both lines, bottom ash sent off-site to a recycler / landfill. Operated under a DBO contract. Both lines and most equipment were installed in 2003.
- "Line 1" / "Line 2" are the two furnaces. "Common" means shared by both lines (cranes, feed water pumps, turbine). "All" means the whole plant.
- Financial year runs 1 April to 31 March. "2019/20" = FY starting April 2019.
- In the star chart, X = completed, P = planned. In the current year 2026/27 there are two columns: Plan (left) and Actual (right). A blank cell means no major work.
- The chart shows only major / capital maintenance. Routine PPM and annual statutory boiler inspections are not on it.
- The work-order CSV is a CMMS export of closed major work orders since 01/04/2022 (the CMMS went live then; earlier work is only on the chart). Dates are DD/MM/YYYY.
- "Man-hours" is the total for the whole crew. A man-day is 8 hours. Where man-hours were not booked, the planner wrote an estimate in Comments.
- Asset names in the CMMS were typed by hand and do not always match the chart, e.g. "Crane 1" / "Crane No1" / "Refuse Crane 1" are all Refuse crane No.1; "BFW Pump A" and "BFP B" are the boiler feed water pumps; "Bag House 1" is Bag filter - Line 1; "Stoker Line 1 - hydraulics" is the hydraulic drive of Stoker grate - Line 1; "Plant (all)" is the whole-plant inspection.
- Boiler 2 superheater replacement (Nov-Dec 2022) was one job raised as two work orders (phase 1 and phase 2).
- The Boiler feed water pump B overhaul was planned for March 2025 but slipped to April 2025 (FY2025/26); the chart still shows the X in 2024/25.
- The Induced draft fan - Line 2 overhaul planned for 2024/25 was never done (no work order); nobody has re-planned it yet.
- The ID fan No.1 bearing change in January 2024 and the Crane 1 emergency rope change in August 2024 were breakdown repairs, not on the chart.
- The "Detailed functional inspection by accredited body" every 3 years is the plant-wide precision function inspection; it covers all equipment.
- The autumn 2026 outage (October-November 2026) will do: Refuse crane No.2 ropes, Stoker grate - Line 2 bars, turbine major overhaul, and the 3-yearly inspection. Dates are not fixed yet.
